SITE_SOCIAL_UNAVAILABLE: No external provider on this hotel
WALLET_SETTINGS_OWN_DESCRIPTION: The first address is the one the hotel holds for you: your Relics and your VortexCoin arrive there, and you have nothing to install to receive them. Connecting a wallet of your own lets you transfer your Relics to it and hold them yourself. Signing costs nothing and authorises no transaction: it only proves the address is yours.
LEADERBOARD_OWN_DESCRIPTION: VortexCoin lives on the hotel's chain: this leaderboard is read straight off the contracts, not out of a game table. Each address is the wallet the hotel holds for a player, and anyone can check its balance.
LEADERBOARD_OWN_DISABLED: This hotel runs no chain, so there is no leaderboard.
HABBO_NFT_OWN_DESCRIPTION: A Relic is a piece of furniture you converted at the Collectors' Guild. The furniture goes, the Relic takes its place — and it really exists, on the hotel's chain.
HABBO_NFT_OWN_MINT: it all happens in game, at the Collectors' Guild. Every Relic carries the furniture's name, its copy number and the size of the edition — and the edition is counted once and for all: the last copy converted is the last that will ever exist. Converting is final; the furniture does not come back.
HABBO_NFT_OWN_OUT_TITLE: Taking it out of the hotel
HABBO_NFT_OWN_OUT: from the Guild's Transfer tab, once a wallet is linked. A Relic that has left counts for nobody here: it leaves your inventory, it no longer trades in game, and it no longer counts towards your collection. It is yours, elsewhere.
HABBO_NFT_OWN_IN: send it to the hotel's treasury from your wallet. It reappears in the Guild's Rewards tab, and goes back to the last player who held it here.
HABBO_NFT_OWN_AVATARS_LEAD: There is no avatar collection on this hotel. What is held here are Relics — converted furniture — and it is the Collectibles tab that explains how they are obtained.
HABBO_NFT_OWN_AVATARS_PERKS_LEAD: What it changes for you in game:
HABBO_NFT_OWN_PERK_MARK: on the Wallet page, every address carries a tick as soon as the chain says it holds at least one Relic. It is read off the contracts, not out of a game table: anyone can check it.
HABBO_NFT_OWN_PERK_COLLECTION: a collection is a list of furniture and a prize for whoever gathers it. A Relic counts there as the furniture it came from, so converting does not lower your score. Once out of the hotel, though, it counts for nobody — not even for you.
HABBO_NFT_OWN_INTRO_CHAIN: They live on the hotel's chain, not on an outside marketplace: each Relic is an ERC-721 token whose number is the one the hotel gave it. You have nothing to install to hold one — the hotel already keeps a wallet for you, to which you can add your own.
HABBO_NFT_OWN_STEPS_LEAD: Here is what you can do with them, and where:
HABBO_NFT_OWN_WALLET: optional, from your settings. The hotel already holds one for you; connecting your own is what lets you take a Relic out of the hotel. Signing costs nothing and authorises no transaction.
WALLET_SETTINGS_OWN_STEP_CONNECT_HINT: The only step the hotel needs. Signing proves the address is yours: it costs nothing, authorises no transaction, and works from any network.
WALLET_SETTINGS_OWN_STEP_NETWORK_HINT: Without it, your wallet sees neither your Relics nor your VortexCoin. Ticked while you are on it: switching back to another network unticks it, and that is not your account changing.
WALLET_SETTINGS_OWN_STEP_COIN_HINT: Optional: a wallet only lists a token once it has been shown one. It cannot tell us whether it already knows it, so this tick only holds for this browser.
WALLET_SETTINGS_OWN_TREASURY_DESCRIPTION: To bring a Relic back into the hotel, send it to this address from your wallet. It reappears in the Collectors' Guild's Rewards tab, and goes back to the last player who held it in the hotel.
